component.name: Home Sync
component.summary: Keep your folders in your cloud, the same on all your computers

description.p: Home Sync keeps folders like Documents, Pictures and Music in your cloud folder (Nextcloud, Dropbox, …) and links them back into your home folder. Everything stays where you know it, and your other computers see the same files.

ul.li: Sets itself up in three steps: cloud folder, folders, done
Shows at a glance what's in sync and what needs attention
Shows what will happen before anything happens; nothing is ever deleted

description.p: Home Sync has its own icon now: a house in the cloud, kept in sync.
First release of Home Sync: set up in three steps, see what's in sync, and fix what isn't, with a preview before anything happens.
